Results: PreInvocation/PostInvocation {injectSteps:[{ephemeralMessage|userMessage|toolCall}]}, PostToolUse {}, Stop {decision, reason}, PreToolUse {decision, reason, overwrite, permissionOverrides}. The app UI also documents matcher values (e.g. "run_command|view_file").

Repo contract (`src/second_brain/adapters/antigravity.py:24-39`, mirrored in `tests/test_antigravity_adapter.py`): PreInvocation → `{"injectSteps":[{"ephemeralMessage":"..."}]}` or `{}`; PostInvocation → `{}` (telemetry only); PostToolUse → `{}`.
Stop → `{}` always (ARCH-01): memory finalization only, Brain never returns a stop/continue decision.
PreToolUse is intentionally not installed; handler returns `{}` with no decision fields — the repo records no `decision/reason/overwrite/permissionOverrides` result fields for it (those appear only in an advisory memory item, not repo code).
Net for writeback: only PreInvocation carries data back to the IDE (`injectSteps[].ephemeralMessage`); every other event writes one empty JSON object.
